summary: Build practical data literacy with Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting exercises. Improve interpretation, analysis, and decision-making.
lede: Data literacy training helps professionals outside analytics teams interpret reports and use evidence in everyday business work. Participants practice cleaning and summarizing data in Excel or Google Sheets, checking data quality, and reading charts to identify trends and outliers. They also learn to explain findings and draft concise, data-informed recommendations for managers.
audienceIntro: This Data Literacy Training Course is designed for professionals who need to interpret, question, and present data in everyday business settings. It fits roles that rely on reports, dashboards, spreadsheets, and management summaries to make defensible decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: no coding is required, but you should have everyday experience using spreadsheets and business reports. A working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, the ability to read basic charts, and access to a laptop during class will help you complete the exercises. This is an intermediate course, so you should already be comfortable entering data, sorting simple tables, and using basic formulas such as SUM and AVERAGE. Recommended preparation: bring a recent report, dashboard screenshot, or spreadsheet from your role so you can apply the exercises to a familiar dataset. Participants who regularly review performance dashboards, KPI packs, or operational reports will gain the most from the hands-on exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
